observation.command:
echo "=== BEFORE ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.type
echo "=== direct redirect, capture bash stderr ==="
echo 0 > /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.threads
echo "redirect_rc=$?"
echo "=== AFTER ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.type
echo "=== strace available? ==="; which strace 2>&1
echo "=== check nsdelegate / cgroup namespace ==="; ls -la /proc/self/ns/cgroup; cat /proc/self/cgroup
